supplied_requirements.envelope_mm: maximum diameter 38.0; overall height 18.0 including 2.0 front hub
supplied_requirements.grip: six equally spaced shallow scallops; minimum grip diameter 33.0 mm; nominal 1.0 mm exposed-edge rounds; subtle raised dots
supplied_requirements.socket: concentric blind D socket, 10.0 mm deep, based on 6.00 mm round diameter and 5.20 mm flat-to-far-round distance, with 0.20 mm radial and flat clearance
supplied_requirements.socket_wall: at least 3.0 mm above socket; no insert, set screw, taper or keyway
supplied_requirements.manufacturing: PETG; P1S; 0.4 mm nozzle; 0.20 mm layers; four walls; 35% infill; installed matching profiles required
supplied_requirements.tolerance: proposed +/-0.25 mm on non-mating surfaces; socket design values kept separate from measured fit
supplied_requirements.review: human review of socket interpretation, orientation, supports and exact final package; no physical-printer transfer or print start

scallops.profile: Subtract six 8.00 mm-radius circular cutters from a 19.00 mm-radius plan disk.
scallops.phase: Cutter centers at 0, 60, 120, 180, 240 and 300 degrees about the socket axis; 0 degrees is +X.

hub.placement: Concentric raised hub on front face, spanning CAD Z=16.0 to 18.0 mm.

dots.placement: One hemispherical-cap dot every 30 degrees with 15-degree phase, on the front grip face at CAD Z=16.0; tops reach Z=16.35 and remain below the hub top.

rounds.treatment: Nominal R1.0 on hand-exposed front and rear outer-profile edges and hub top perimeter; blend tangent through scallop/lobe transitions. Socket boundary is excluded as a mating feature; dots use smooth domed caps.

socket.construction: Start with the cleared round boundary: 3.00 mm shaft radius plus 0.20 mm radial clearance. The shaft flat is at X=-2.20 mm because its far round point is X=+3.00 mm and the specified distance is 5.20 mm; move the cavity flat outward by 0.20 mm to X=-2.40 mm. Use the intersection of the radius-3.20 mm disk and half-plane X>=-2.40 mm.
socket.depth_direction: CAD rear face is Z=0; socket opens there and extends toward the front to Z=10.0.

proposed_geometry.orientation: Propose socket mouth upward for slicing, with CAD -Z aligned to machine +Z and front hub toward the build plate. Keep supports out of the socket; support need beneath the front annulus is deferred to slicer inspection.

basis_review: Approve scallop cutter radius, 2.25 mm depth, 33.5 mm valley diameter and angular phase.
Approve 13.0 x 2.0 mm hub, twelve 1.4 x 0.35 mm dots and their placement.
Approve exposed-edge treatment and exclusion of the mating socket edge.
Approve the cleared D construction, flat side at -X, rear opening and depth direction.
Approve socket-up orientation intent and acceptance that slicer review determines supports.
remaining_verification: Inspect generated geometry for envelope, grip minimum, rounds, dot clearance, socket dimensions, depth and remaining material.
Inspect source/repaired mesh lineage and mesh integrity without changing approved geometry.
Inspect actual orientation, support regions, socket exclusion and slicing preview.
Verify installed P1S 0.4 mm PETG profiles, 0.20 mm layers, four walls and 35% infill.
Review the exact final package and digest-bound simulated local transfer receipt.
Measure any artifact and assess fit, strength, accuracy and print outcome later; none is claimed by this proposal.
